prompt:
Use case: logo-brand. Make a pristine minimalist flat typographic game logo, referencing ONLY the attached hand sketch for composition and letter proportions. Use a perfectly solid pure BLACK (#000000) opaque background. White line work only, like immaculate technical vector drawing, absolutely no texture.

Exact text "Chrono" on upper line, "Chain" on lower line, lower line indented to the right. Very tall slender capital C and h, much smaller lowercase rono and ain, following the sketch's layout. Small plain Korean "크로노 체인" at the right between the English baselines. The English letter strokes are literally fine chains: single-file small interlocking elongated oval OUTLINE links tracing the centerline of each letter. Each individual oval has a thin WHITE outline and BLACK hollow interior. All chain links thin and delicate, never solid chunky shapes. Thin round handwritten-like letter structure, airy editorial design, legible. Korean a small simple single-weight sans-serif. Do not add any other text.

Strictly two colors, WHITE fine lines on pure BLACK. NO TRANSPARENCY. No glowing edges, lighting, metallic material, shadows, bevels, textures, distressed ink, noise, speckles, smudges, patterns, gradients, extra ornaments, clocks or decorative chains. All negative space is PERFECTLY solid black. High contrast spare flat minimalist wordmark. Center the entire logo group in a square canvas with generous 12% margins. This is clean typography, not a fantasy emblem.
